thread:
lia (prodops): Heads-up: starting next week we’re enabling Region Lock for Private/VPC customers — a tenancy-level control to pin workloads and logs to a selected geo (us-west, eu-central, ap-sg). Docs + onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbook/region-locking :spiral_notepad:
lia (prodops): This is the data-residency control we committed to in contracts. Rollout = opt-in for existing Private installs during a 60-day migration window. New installs can set it during provisioning.
matt (eng-platform): Tech note — Region Lock enforces egress firewall rules and storage-region tagging. No model-serving binary changes. Initial migration requires re-provisioning the routing layer for pinned pods. Expect customer-visible maintenance of ~10-20m during the cutover.
jenna (sales-ps): FYI — Sales & PS need a short comms piece and a contract addendum template for customers who want to lock regions. Sophie, can Legal draft that?
sophie (legal): On it. I'll draft a standard SLA amendment + privacy impact blurb. Please send pilot roster and dates so I can scope jurisdiction-specific clauses.
lia (prodops): Pilot roster is in the runbook link. Pilot starts Mon: 1879005600. We'll onboard 5 low-traffic customers first. Opsbot will create the epic and workstreams.
opsbot: New epic created: REGION-LOCK-PILOT (#4502). Auto-assign: prodops, eng-platform, cs. Link: https://redwood.internal/boards/epic/4502
kyle (customer-success): Customers asked whether there’s a dry-run mode to validate without switching production traffic — so they can test egress and logs.
matt (eng-platform): Yes — dry-run validates routing, telemetry and storage tags without flipping traffic. CLI example:
```
# dry-run for ACME
rwctl private region-lock --customer=ACME --region=eu-central --dry-run
```
lia (prodops): We also built a migration assistant that will estimate expected downtime, produce step-by-step commands, and collect pre/post checks. Migration logs retained for 180 days.
sam (vp-product): Nice. Two asks: 1) please prepare a 1-pager exec summary for Sales/AMs, 2) add a Console metric: "Locked Regions %" so leadership can track adoption.
jenna (sales-ps): Will do the exec 1-pager. For AMs: what's the UX to opt in?
lia (prodops): Console path: Private > Settings > Region Lock. Toggle + dropdown for region. Default for existing customers = off. Opt-in triggers auto-generation of the legal amendment and an email for e-sign.
sophie (legal): Confirmed — amendment auto-gen + e-sign flow included. For EU customers we’ll attach the Data Processor Addendum where required.
kyle (customer-success): Can we schedule a 30-min training for CS + AMs? Wed 10am PT works for most of the team.
lia (prodops): Booked — calendar invite out.
matt (eng-platform): Rollout plan: pilot Mon -> progressive opt-ins over a 60-day window -> GA +30d after pilot success. We’ll monitor latency/error dashboards closely during pilot.
lia (prodops): Action items (short): 1) Eng: finalize dry-run CLI & migration assistant by EOD Fri; 2) Legal: amendment draft by Tue; 3) CS/Sales: exec summary + training invites by Wed. I’ll post a status update Friday.
jenna (sales-ps): noted :thumbsup:
